title: Comunicado 2025-06-26
summary: Banxico's Board cut the policy rate 50bp to 8.00%, but the decision was a divided 4-1 (Heath dissenting for a hold at 8.50%) and the forward guidance was softened to 'valorara recortes adicionales' without the previous commitment to a similar-magnitude move, so the message is a dovish action carrying a distinctly more cautious, hawkish tilt. Versus the 27 March communique (a unanimous 50bp cut that explicitly signaled another adjustment of similar magnitude), the two key changes are the return of Heath's dissent and the dropping of the 50bp guidance, alongside a deterioration in the inflation data. Headline inflation rose from 3.93% to 4.51% and core from 3.93% to 4.20%, 2025 headline expectations increased and the forecasts were revised up, with services disinflation more gradual and goods inflation higher than expected. The balance of inflation risks remains tilted to the upside (though judged less pronounced than in 2021-2024), while the cut is justified by peso appreciation, economic slack/weak activity and trade-policy uncertainty. Trade tensions and US policy remain the dominant external theme, with two-sided inflation effects flagged.

key_quotes.quote: la Junta de Gobierno con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por mayoría reducir en 50 puntos base el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día a un nivel de 8.00%.
key_quotes.context: Corte de 50bp, agora por maioria (não mais unânime como em março)

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno valorará recortes adicionales a la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Guidance suavizado: avaliará cortes adicionais, sem a promessa anterior de magnitude similar (50bp)

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza, si bien este es menos pronunciado que el enfrentado entre 2021 y 2024.
key_quotes.context: Balanço de riscos inflacionários segue de alta; inflação surpreendeu para cima e pronósticos revisados ao alza

key_quotes.quote: Votó a favor de mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en un nivel de 8.50% Jonathan Heath.
key_quotes.context: Retorno da dissidência de Heath, que preferia manter a taxa
